# third_party/a2a_mcp

Compatibility patches + driver for the **Phase 5 off-the-shelf** target: Google's
`a2a_mcp` travel-planning sample (`google-a2a/a2a-samples`, upstream commit `22b48d5`).

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `a2a_mcp_compat.patch` | `git diff` of the 8 compat fixes (7 source files; `uv.lock` excluded — regenerated by `uv sync`). Apply with `git apply` inside a clean `a2a-samples` checkout. |
| `trip_driver.py` | Non-interactive multi-turn A2A driver (auto-answers the planner). Copy into `samples/python/agents/a2a_mcp/`. No credentials. |
| `trip_driver_boosted.py` | Fan-out-boosted driver (destination-agnostic, forces full-service answers) used for the instance-2 specialist top-up (`scripts/collect_offtheshelf_6way.sh`, RESULTS §9b). |
| `trip_driver_natural.py` | Bug-fixed but not completion-forcing driver used for the de-confounded natural re-run (`scripts/collect_offtheshelf_natural.sh`, RESULTS §9b′). |

The capture label files record the drivers under their earlier names (`drive_orch.py`,
`drive_orch_boost.py`, `drive_orch_natural_fixed.py`); they are the same scripts.

**Full setup, the 8-fix table, and capture/extract commands:**
see [`docs/A2A_MCP_SETUP.md`](../../docs/A2A_MCP_SETUP.md).

The Gemini API key lives only in the external `.env` on the capture host — it is **never**
copied or committed here.

Scope: this external system corroborates open-world **detection** + **topology
observability** of a system we did not build. It yields **no** role/workflow transfer
number (its labels do not align with our taxonomy).
